---
name: pr-preparation
description: Check readiness and prepare a truthful pull request summary.
---
# PR preparation
1. Inspect Git status, branch, diff, and changed files.
2. Map changes to approved criteria.
3. Verify which tests actually ran and their results.
4. Check unresolved findings, secrets, generated files, unrelated edits, and docs.
5. Summarize what changed and why.
6. Draft a PR title/body with implementation, tests, limitations, and risks.
7. State readiness as Ready, Ready with caveats, or Not ready.
Preparation does not authorize staging, committing, pushing, creating a PR, merging, or deploying. Ask for explicit approval before each external action.
